title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 0.33 (quiet) at 22:00 UTC on 20 September 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 9 月 20 日 22:00 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 0.33（平靜）。

summary.en: Latest hour-start estimated Kp = 0.33 (label 0P). Last-180 maximum 1.00 at 22:18 UTC (label 1Z; last-180 window from about 20:01 UTC). Published-window maximum 1.00 at 22:18 UTC. Window start 17:03 UTC (358 samples). 23:00 UTC is 0.00/0Z immediately after 22:59 0.00/0Z and is treated as a new-minute placeholder, not used as the card value. estimated_kp remains below 5.0.
summary.zh: 最新整點估計 Kp = 0.33（標籤 0P）。近 180 筆最大 1.00（22:18 UTC；標籤 1Z；近 180 筆窗約自 20:01 UTC 起）；公開窗最大 1.00（22:18 UTC）。窗起點 17:03 UTC（358 筆）。23:00 UTC 為 0.00／0Z，緊接 22:59 的 0.00／0Z，視為新分鐘占位，不採為卡片數值。estimated_kp 仍低於 5.0。

evidence.method: Read the public 1-minute estimated planetary K-index JSON. Use the latest published hour-start minute that is not a trailing 0.00/0Z placeholder (22:00 UTC). Report last-180 and full published-window maxima.
evidence.limitations: estimated_kp is a near-real-time estimate, not the final observatory Kp. The public file is a rolling ~6-hour window and older samples drop off.
